name: flaggems_weight_int4pack_mm_with_scales_and_zeros
description: Groupwise int4 asymmetric weight-only quantized GEMM (XPU _weight_int4pack_mm_with_scales_and_zeros semantics): out[m,n] = sum_k self[m,k] * qScale[k/gs,n] * (w_int4[k,n] - qZeros[k/gs,n]) where mat2 is the int32-packed int4 weight of shape [N, K/8] and qScale/qZeros have shape [K/gs, N].
reference:
import torch

def gen_inputs(ctx, device):
    m, k = ctx['self__shape']
    n, kpack = ctx['mat2__shape']
    gs = ctx['qGroupSize']
    self_dtype = getattr(torch, ctx['self__dtype'])
    scale_dtype = getattr(torch, ctx['qScale__dtype'])
    # random uint4 weight values 0..15
    w = torch.randint(0, 16, (n, k), device=device)
    # pack 2 consecutive k-values per byte, then 4 bytes per int32 (little-endian)
    packed = (w[:, 1::2] << 4 | w[:, ::2]).to(torch.uint8)
    mat2 = packed.view(torch.int32)
    act = torch.randn(m, k, dtype=self_dtype, device=device) * 0.5
    ngroups = k // gs
    # realistic positive groupwise scales in [0.01, 0.03]
    scale = torch.rand(ngroups, n, dtype=scale_dtype, device=device) * 0.02 + 0.01
    zeros = torch.randint(0, 16, (ngroups, n), dtype=torch.int8, device=device)
    return {'self': act, 'mat2': mat2, 'qScale': scale, 'qZeros': zeros}

def run(self, mat2, qGroupSize, qScale, qZeros):
    n = mat2.shape[0]
    k = self.shape[1]
    gs = qGroupSize
    shifts = torch.arange(4, dtype=torch.int64, device=mat2.device) * 8
    bytes_ = (mat2[..., None].to(torch.int64) >> shifts) & 0xFF
    w_even = bytes_ & 0xF
    w_odd = (bytes_ >> 4) & 0xF
    w = torch.stack((w_even, w_odd), dim=-1).reshape(n, k).float()
    scale = qScale.repeat_interleave(gs, dim=0).float()
    zero = qZeros.repeat_interleave(gs, dim=0).float()
    dequant = (w - zero.t()) * scale.t()
    out = torch.matmul(self.float(), dequant.t())
    return out.to(self.dtype)

def run_correctness(self, mat2, qGroupSize, qScale, qZeros):
    n = mat2.shape[0]
    k = self.shape[1]
    gs = qGroupSize
    shifts = torch.arange(4, dtype=torch.int64, device=mat2.device) * 8
    bytes_ = (mat2[..., None].to(torch.int64) >> shifts) & 0xFF
    w_even = bytes_ & 0xF
    w_odd = (bytes_ >> 4) & 0xF
    w = torch.stack((w_even, w_odd), dim=-1).reshape(n, k).to(torch.float64)
    scale = qScale.to(torch.float64).repeat_interleave(gs, dim=0)
    zero = qZeros.to(torch.float64).repeat_interleave(gs, dim=0)
    dequant = (w - zero.t()) * scale.t()
    out = torch.matmul(self.to(torch.float64), dequant.t())
    return out.to(self.dtype)
